citations.assessment: Directly names Pappos ben Yehudah and records the imprisonment exchange with R. Akiva after his arrest.
Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:9:3 tells the Gamliel and Yehoshua story with the reversed patronymic, precisely supporting Heilprin’s objection. The internal Yehudah ben Pappos entry repeats it.
